name: RarePepesForever🐸
description:
Rare Pepes sparked the revolution.

RarePepesForever is an independent preservation project dedicated to preserving the artwork and history of the original Rare Pepe card series on Fractal Bitcoin.

Originally issued in 2016, the Rare Pepe artwork is being preserved fully on-chain — no IPFS, no external image hosting, no fade.

1,774 pieces of crypto history, permanently etched for future generations.

This is not a reissue, replacement or official continuation of the original Rare Pepe collection. We are not affiliated with the original artists or project. Our purpose is preservation: keeping the original artwork, artist references, card history and cultural context accessible on-chain.

Rare Pepes continue to inspire collectors, creators, builders and communities across the crypto ecosystem.

Explore the original Rare Pepe card series and history:
https://rarepepes.com/collection/series-1/

RarePepesForever lives on through PEPEStake — an independent Fractal Bitcoin indexer built by collectors, for collectors.
